name: Singapore-Airbnb (STA violation viz)
what_it_holds: "A data analysis project to visualize listings that violate the STA laws in Singapore" (Singapore's Short-Term Accommodation Act, which effectively bans most Airbnb-style STR). GPL-3.0, 1 star, updated 2026-08-17.
why_useful: Singapore is one of the theme's named markets and has an outright STR ban with enforcement; a repo explicitly built to flag STA-law violators among listing data is a regulation-relevant angle (gap #12) rather than a generic price-prediction notebook, though the underlying listings data is likely a static Kaggle/Inside-Airbnb snapshot.
duplicate_of_holding: Likely duplicates a standard Kaggle/Inside-Airbnb Singapore listings snapshot we may already have access to; flagged for its regulatory-violation angle, not new raw data.

name: cfpb/ccdb5-ui
what_it_holds: Official CFPB GitHub org's front-end (JavaScript) for the Consumer Complaint Database search UI (consumerfinance.gov/complaint database), not the bulk data itself; the underlying complaint records (including travel/lodging, prepaid card, and BNPL complaint categories, since 2011, with company response and product/sub-product tags) are pulled separately via the CFPB's own Socrata-style bulk CSV/API, which this UI queries. Actively maintained (7 stars, updated 11 Sep 2026).
why_useful: The underlying complaint database (once pulled via the public API this UI hits) could give a free, point-in-time-taggable proxy for lodging-booking friction, cancellation disputes, and BNPL/prepaid-card complaint volume relevant to the RNPL thesis; this repo is only the client, so it is cataloged as a method/pointer, not a dataset — a follow-up agent should locate the actual bulk-export endpoint or a mirror repo of the CSV dumps.
time_coverage: 2011-present (underlying database), UI repo itself has no data
